To Whom It May Concern,  

I’ve collaborated with Gita Saxena on several consulting projects at NexGen Solutions, primarily as a peer contributor. We’ve worked occasionally on cross-team initiatives, often aligning her full-stack expertise with our agency’s client-facing efforts. Her ability to bridge technical complexity with client needs has made her a reliable collaborator.  

Gita’s strength lies in her problem-solving approach and adaptability. During a recent project for a healthcare client, she swiftly rearchitected a legacy system using PostgreSQL and React, reducing load times by 40% without downtime. She also streamlined deployment processes by integrating GitLab CI, which cut manual steps by half. Her technical depth extends to AWS and Terraform, though she prioritizes solutions that align with business goals over tool-centric overhauls.  

What stands out is her work ethic. She consistently meets tight deadlines while mentoring junior team members. For example, during a sprint to launch a SaaS product, she took the lead on API design, ensuring RESTful principles were rigorously applied. Her calm under pressure and willingness to iterate based on feedback made the team more efficient.  

Gita is a dependable professional who balances technical rigor with client-centric thinking. I’d recommend her without hesitation for roles requiring both innovation and reliability.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Full Name]  
[Your Contact Information]
